issues.title: TestUnmarshalVectorRejectsNestedCountBeforeAllocating measures process-wide allocation,…
issues.verdictReason: The test compares runtime.MemStats.TotalAlloc, a process-wide counter, against a 128 KB threshold (payload/8 with payload=1<<20); any goroutine allocating in the background during the measurement window could in principle push the delta over the limit.
